orbis_current_schema_preview.current_schema: Country -> Division -> State(District or City Corporation) -> City(Upazila, Thana, or Paurashava) -> UnionWard(Union or Ward No) -> existing detailed address fields. Address.union_name remains a legacy free-text fallback.

field_label_plan.detailed_address: Use the existing flat_no, holding_no, village_area, and post_code fields after Union / Ward No.

notes_before_import: State intentionally stores either a district or a city corporation for the current Bangladesh-only schema.
City rows stay scoped to their State parent, so the same thana name can exist under a district State, a city-corporation State, or a paurashava City without becoming one shared row.
Paurashava rows are equivalent to upazila/thana selection level for this address UI. They are imported as City rows under their district, not as UnionWard rows under an upazila.

Union rows are prepared for district/upazila addresses; city corporation ward data still needs an authoritative source. The import command seeds UnionWard rows and keeps Address.union_name as a free-text fallback.
